description: Phase 2E: drives the soak-only WG sub-engine memory gauge past the 38 MiB watermark on day 2, then forces a one-way handoff event. Asserts the diagnostics surface carries `wg_subengine_memory_kib` and `wg_subengine_handoff_at` after the forced handoff. The boringtun side is mocked as a Go shim for soak purposes; the real Rust archive is exercised only on Apple CI / partner-mac on-device.
